description: G-5-199, delivered 11 May 1949 as I-099, retired 31 December 1970; on a plinth at the airport entrance wearing the incorrect serial C-093 (es.wikipedia, Más Neuquén 2022; a C-071 marking was also reported after a 2000s repaint), now in deplorable condition (Más Neuquén, June 2022). Photographed January 2014.
aliases: Meteor F4; Meteor F Mk 4; I-099; C-093; C-071; I099; C093; C071
